purpose: Quantify lung injury architecture and inflammatory-cell-rich morphology in H&E whole-slide images without inferring immune lineage from H&E alone.
hard_rules: H&E never enters the fluorescence Fiji measurement engine.
A section is not an independent biological replicate.
Immune lineage is not inferred from H&E morphology alone.
A failed identity, calibration, artifact, or completeness gate prevents mouse-level output.
Fractions are pooled from numerators and denominators, never averaged across fields or sections.

stages.name: modality_and_series_identity
stages.decision: Accept only calibrated RGB brightfield analytical series declared by the study profile.

stages.name: sample_and_section_identity
stages.decision: Resolve mouse, genotype, infection, slide, and section before measurement.

stages.name: stain_and_scan_qc
stages.decision: Estimate H&E stain vectors during pilot work, then freeze a reviewed batch profile.

stages.name: tissue_and_artifact_mask
stages.decision: Separate usable tissue from glass and exclude pen, dust, folds, tears, blur, bubbles, and saturated material.

stages.name: anatomical_compartment
stages.decision: Assign airway, peribronchial, vascular, perivascular, alveolar, pleural, or unresolved geography before lesion interpretation.

stages.name: candidate_injury_regions
stages.decision: Density, optical-density, airspace loss, and texture may nominate candidate inflammatory or consolidated regions.

stages.name: morphology_authorization
stages.decision: Topology and compartment-compatible morphology authorize consolidation, cuffing, epithelial injury, and inflammatory-cell-rich calls.

stages.name: blinded_review
stages.decision: A blinded reviewer accepts, edits, or rejects masks and ordinal scores on a locked review set.

stages.name: section_to_mouse_aggregation
stages.decision: Pool section numerators and denominators within mouse; report section agreement as technical QC.

stages.name: multimodal_association
stages.decision: Join H&E injury burden to IF pod and epithelial-state endpoints at mouse level unless serial-section correspondence has been independently validated.
